endpoints.description: List user dipaginasi dengan nama Business Unit terkait, opsional filter role/business_unit_id
Membuat user baru dengan role dan Business Unit terkait

body_schema.username: string, required, max 255, tanpa spasi (regex ^\S+$), unik case-insensitive (lower(username))
body_schema.name: string, required
body_schema.business_unit_id: uuid, required jika role != admin, harus Business Unit yang ada
body_schema.password: string, required, App\Support\PasswordPolicy (min 6 karakter, alfanumerik+simbol — sama dengan login)

error_codes.condition: username kosong/mengandung spasi/sudah dipakai (case-insensitive), name kosong, role tidak valid, business_unit_id kosong padahal role!=admin atau tidak valid, atau password tidak memenuhi PasswordPolicy

endpoints.description: Mengubah nama, role, dan Business Unit user. Endpoint API tidak meneruskan password (UserController::update hanya name/role/business_unit_id); Reset Password opsional hanya tersedia lewat form Edit Livewire yang memanggil UserService::update() dengan field password

body_schema.name: string, required
body_schema.business_unit_id: uuid, required jika role != admin, harus Business Unit yang ada

error_codes.condition: name kosong, role tidak valid, business_unit_id kosong padahal role!=admin atau tidak valid

endpoints.description: Mengubah status aktif/nonaktif user (toggle dari daftar; Nonaktifkan dengan konfirmasi di UI). Penonaktifan mencabut seluruh token Sanctum user tsb; sesi web-nya dikeluarkan EnsureUserIsActive pada request berikutnya

error_codes.condition: Admin mencoba menonaktifkan (is_active=false) akun miliknya sendiri yang sedang login

business_logic: 1. GET list: paginate sesuai shared-decisions.pagination, filter opsional by role/business_unit_id, eager-load businessUnit untuk business_unit_name. password_hash tidak pernah diekspos (sudah $hidden di model)

2. POST create: validate username required + max 255 + tanpa spasi + unik case-insensitive (UserService::usernameUniqueRule, lower() di kedua sisi) → validate name required → validate role required (enum) → validate business_unit_id required jika role != admin, harus Business Unit yang ada → validate password required + PasswordPolicy::rule() → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → hash password → insert User baru dengan is_active=true

3. PATCH update: validate id ada → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → validate name/role/business_unit_id (sama seperti create) → bila password tidak kosong: validate PasswordPolicy → if invalid: return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR → update name, role, business_unit_id; password_hash hanya diganti bila password diisi (Reset Password, kosong = tidak berubah). Username tidak pernah diubah

4. PATCH status: validate id ada → if not: return 404 NOT_FOUND → jika is_active=false DAN id == id user yang login: return 409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF → else update is_active; bila dinonaktifkan: hapus seluruh token Sanctum user tsb ($user->tokens()->delete())

data_operations.description: SELECT User dipaginasi dengan Business Unit terkait, opsional filter role/business_unit_id; SELECT untuk validasi id ada saat update/status
INSERT User baru dengan password_hash ter-hash

SELECT untuk validasi business_unit_id ada saat create/update; dropdown Business Unit di FE memakai endpoint publik GET /api/business-units (screen-029) yang sudah ada, tidak perlu endpoint baru

edge_case_handling.condition: username sudah dipakai user lain (termasuk beda huruf besar/kecil saja)
edge_case_handling.handling: Return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR dengan errors.username 'Username sudah digunakan.'

edge_case_handling.condition: password (create, atau Reset Password saat edit) tidak memenuhi PasswordPolicy
Admin mencoba menonaktifkan akun miliknya sendiri

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 422 VALIDATION_ERROR dengan errors.username 'Username tidak boleh mengandung spasi.'

business_rules_applied: Username harus unik di seluruh sistem (case-insensitive) dan tanpa spasi
Role selain Admin wajib memiliki Business Unit terkait
Admin tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun miliknya sendiri
User tidak dihapus permanen, hanya dinonaktifkan (tidak ada endpoint DELETE)
Password awal ditentukan Admin saat membuat user baru
Hanya Admin yang dapat mengakses layar ini

unit_test_cases.description: returns paginated user list with business_unit_name for each row
unit_test_cases.given: UserRepository.findPaginated() returns rows joined with BusinessUnit
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with data array including business_unit_name per row, plus pagination meta

unit_test_cases.description: filters list by role and business_unit_id when provided
unit_test_cases.given: query params role=supervisor and business_unit_id=X are provided
unit_test_cases.expect: only users matching both filters are returned

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when creating user with duplicate username
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.username; http 422 VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when creating user with role != admin and no business_unit_id
unit_test_cases.given: role is 'supervisor' and business_unit_id is null
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.business_unit_id; http 422 VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: allows creating an Admin user without business_unit_id
unit_test_cases.given: role is 'admin' and business_unit_id is null
unit_test_cases.expect: user created successfully with business_unit_id null

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when creating user with invalid business_unit_id
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.business_unit_id; http 422 VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR when password does not satisfy PasswordPolicy
unit_test_cases.given: input password shorter than 6 characters or without a symbol (e.g. 'abcdef')
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with errors.password; http 422 VALIDATION_ERROR

unit_test_cases.description: hashes the password before storing on create
unit_test_cases.expect: stored password_hash is a bcrypt hash, not the plain-text password

unit_test_cases.description: returns 404 NOT_FOUND when updating/setting status of a non-existent user id
update changes password_hash only when Reset Password is filled
unit_test_cases.given: update input without password (or empty) vs. with a valid password
unit_test_cases.expect: empty → password_hash unchanged; filled → password_hash re-hashed and new password works for login; invalid filled password → 422

unit_test_cases.description: returns 409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF when the acting admin sets is_active=false on their own user id
unit_test_cases.given: path id == acting user's own id, body is_active=false
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ConflictException; http 409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF; is_active unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: allows an admin to deactivate a different user
unit_test_cases.given: path id != acting user's own id, body is_active=false

unit_test_cases.description: allows an admin to reactivate their own account is_active=true (only deactivation of self is blocked, not reactivation)
unit_test_cases.given: path id == acting user's own id, body is_active=true
unit_test_cases.expect: is_active updated to true, no error

unit_test_cases.description: returns 403 FORBIDDEN for all endpoints when authenticated user is not Admin
rejects a username that differs only by letter case, and a username containing spaces
unit_test_cases.given: existing user 'operator01'; create with 'OPERATOR01' or 'user dua'

unit_test_cases.description: deactivating a user revokes their Sanctum tokens
unit_test_cases.given: target user has personal access tokens; setStatus(id, false)
unit_test_cases.expect: all tokens of that user deleted; token requests with them answer 401

screen_dependencies.reason: Dropdown Business Unit memakai endpoint publik GET /api/business-units yang sudah ada dari screen-029; role selain Admin butuh Business Unit yang sudah dibuat lebih dulu

implementation_notes: 403 FORBIDDEN pada seluruh endpoint disimpulkan dari actor_permissions, sama seperti screen-027/028/029
Livewire component memanggil Service Layer yang sama dengan REST API, konsisten dengan pola screen sebelumnya
password_hash tidak pernah diekspos di response manapun (sudah $hidden di model User)

Endpoint status (PATCH /api/users/:id/status) dipisah dari update (PATCH /api/users/:id) agar toggle aktif/nonaktif dari daftar tidak perlu membuka form penuh dan tidak bisa tidak sengaja mengubah field lain
Tidak ada endpoint DELETE — user tidak pernah dihapus permanen, hanya endpoint status yang mengubah is_active
Validasi hanya hidup di UserService::validate() — komponen Livewire tidak lagi punya rules() sendiri; ValidationException dipetakan ke kunci form.*
Label role memakai UserRole::label() (Mill Management, bukan 'Mill management')
